age_sensitivity: Age at end of 2021 from birth year. The sensitivity removes ages 25, 45 and 65, which can be below their group threshold on interview day.
comparison_scope: Separate national cross-sections with source-defined groups. The mental health recall period and household income reference year change between waves. These are descriptive comparisons within each wave.

metric_labels.food_insufficiency: Adults reporting that their household sometimes or often did not have enough food in the previous seven days
metric_labels.mental_health_screen: Adults screening positive for anxiety or depression symptoms using the wave's recall period

nonresponse_scope: Item bounds apply within each age band among respondents. Household unit response rates remain separate. Replicate intervals do not measure selection bias.
standard_source: NCHS United States year 2000 projected standard million, scaled to the population aged 25 and older
